svg.text: The same read as above. y: each window's own coordinates, contig Mb, on CM089362.1 (a, c) or CM089354.1 (b).
In b the read's first part runs off D's end into a gap, and its second part starts only at B's first base: the 2,279 bp
between them, across the junction, are in no piece of the other copy (only in M, and in the father's A and E).
